🔊 Iran well-prepared for ‘historic’ funeral ceremonies of martyred Leader

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Preparations are in full swing for the funeral ceremonies of the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, who lost his life in an airstike by the US and Israeli terrorit regimes on his office in Tehran on the first day of the imposed war of aggression against Iran.

The ceremonies will start with processions in Tehran on July 4, according to Brigadier General Hassan Hassanzadeh, who heads the headquarters dedicated to the martyred leader’s funeral ceremonies.
​
Hassanzadeh, who is also the commander of the Mohammad Rasoulallah Unit of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps in Tehran, made the remarks on state TV on Monday evening.
​
He described the upcoming funeral as “a historic event,” saying that millions of mourners are expected to turn out.
​
The commander said that the ceremony to bid farewell to the martyred leader will take place at Tehran’s Grand Mosalla, beginning at 6 a.m. local time on July 4. Prayers will be performed a day later, and the farewell ceremony will continue through the evening of July 5, he added.
​
Ceremonies are also planned for July 6, according to the official. He said that preparations are in full swing to host the large number of attendees, with designated routes stretching from eastern to western Tehran to ensure the crowds move smoothly.
​
Stations will be set up to accommodate elderly people, patients, and children, while medical teams will be deployed to provide services, Hassanzadeh noted.
​
According to the official, ceremonies to honor the martyred leader are also planned in the holy cities of Qom and Mashhad. The processions will conclude on July 9 in Mashhad, where the martyred leader will be laid to rest.

Milford Sound, New Zealand 🇳🇿🌊⛰

Carved by ancient glaciers within Fiordland National Park, Milford Sound is hailed as the "eighth wonder of the world." Towering cliffs rise dramatically from deep, inky waters, and waterfalls like Stirling and Bowen Falls plummet hundreds of meters down into the fjord.

Dolphins, fur seals, and the occasional penguin inhabit these rugged shores, while ever-shifting mist and frequent rain clothe the peaks in mystery. On rare clear days, Mitre Peak’s reflection glimmers perfectly in the calm waters—an image iconic to New Zealand’s wild beauty.

📡 Hamas: Global silence on Israeli massacre of Gaza children is complicity in crimes

📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Palestinian resistance movement, Hamas, condemns Israel’s continued deliberate targeting and killing of children in the Gaza Strip, stressing that the world’s silence over the bloodshed is complicity in the crimes of the occupying regime.

In a statement cited by the Palestinian Shahab news agency on Tuesday, Hamas spokesperson Hazem Qassem referred to the global inaction, while announcing the martyrdom of a little girl in Monday's Israeli airstrike on refugee tents in the city of Khan Yunis, southern Gaza.
​
According to him, the latest victim is among tens of thousands of Palestinian children who have lost their lives amid bombing, hunger, deprivation of medical care, or due to the loss of their parents in the attacks.
​
Stressing that the world keeps watching and hearing the ongoing crimes but does nothing, Qassem, in particular, slammed the Arab League, as well as political groups, parliaments, scholars, and elites of the Arab world, for their silence on the Israeli mayhem.
​
The spokesperson said those who have maintained silence are accomplices as their stance only emboldens Israel and paves the way for the regime to continue its genocidal war in Gaza and atrocities elsewhere in the occupied territories.
​
Medical sources announced the killing of at least eight Palestinians, including two children, and the injury of over 40 people in Israeli airstrikes on various areas of the Strip on Monday.
​
The total death toll from Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, which began on October 7, 2023, has now reached 73,058, with 173,488 wounded, according to the Gaza Health Ministry.
​
More than one thousand Palestinians have been killed since early October last year, as Israel has continued pounding Gaza in violation of a so-called ceasefire brokered by the United States.

🔻 Iran, France foreign ministers discuss regional developments over phone

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and French Foreign Minister Jean Noel Barrot have held a telephone conversation to review recent developments in the region.

During the call late on Monday, the two sides reviewed the latest regional and international developments in light of the provisions of the Islamabad memorandum of understanding (MoU) and its implementation process as part of continued consultations between Tehran and Washington.
​
The two officials also exchanged views on the ongoing diplomatic efforts aimed at ending the war imposed by the United States and the Israeli regime against Iran, focusing on the broader implications of the memorandum and the current regional situation.
